verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation that Gemini creates documents or presentations, revises them over successive turns, or exports them as files. What it does show belongs to other stories and earns no credit here: image generation and download, general writing help, and a vague claim that Gemini can edit content in other connected apps.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export
